Marco (net): getting alert: inter-region egress errors spiking across eu->us traffic at ~21:12 UTC. Some customers see timeouts when routing to hosted endpoints.
Zoe (sre): seeing TCP resets and packet drops on backbone peering links. BGP flaps reported on transit-2.
Marco (net): any scheduled maintenance on transit providers?
Infra-bot: provider maintenance notice: fast-ntwk provider scheduled window 21:00-21:30 UTC for upstream peering refresh.
Zoe (sre): seems correlated. mitigation plan: 1) shift traffic away from transit-2 via policy override, 2) enable retries and extended timeouts at edge LB for in-flight requests, 3) monitor customer error rates.
Marco (net): applying policy now to move eu->us egress to transit-1 and transit-3.
Zoe (sre): implemented policy override, traffic rebalanced.
Ada (cs): customers reporting degraded experience; sending brief notice and status link.
Status-bot: incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1780604321.
Marco (net): edge LB retry policy increased from 3->6 attempts and timeout per try from 3s->6s.
Zoe (sre): early metrics: 5xx rate down from 9.8% -> 1.7% in last 8 minutes, p95 latency back to normal for most regions. Some long-tail retries still failing for a handful of tenants behind strict client timeouts.
Ada (cs): marking affected tenants and contacting them with recommended client-side timeout increase for graceful recovery.
Marco (net): transit provider confirms flaps resolved at 21:24 UTC; reaching out for RCA.
Zoe (sre): current status: mitigated for majority; residual customer-impact for <0.5% requests. changing incident to "mitigated - monitoring".
Marco (net): follow-ups: add provider maintenance into our traffic failover playbook, automate provider-change runbook, and add synthetic checks for inter-region egress.
Ada (cs): posted update to customers; will share draft of postmortem timeline once logs are consolidated.
Zoe (sre): scheduling 30-min blameless review tomorrow 11:00 UTC. attach packet captures and BGP logs to incident doc.
Marco (net): thanks team. good recovery work. :tada:
